title: Settings
pushBlocked: Push is blocked in your browser. Allow notifications via the padlock icon in the address bar.

emailOfflineHint: While you are online, you only get push notifications.
reduceMotionHint: Less movement of the camera, transitions and highlights.
combatAnimationsHint: Explosions and muzzle flashes on the battlefield. Without them only the result appears.

turnReport: Turn report at the start of your turn
turnReportHint: A summary at the start of your turn: losses, battles, cities, discoveries and enemy moves seen.
mutedHint: Turns off all sounds and the music.
ambienceHint: Surf, wind, factory noise, depending on the map view
rightClickHint: “Cancel” takes back selection and preview on the board step by step.

zoomHint: For the mouse wheel and two-finger gesture
